decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied or used at any time as a separate independent residential unit and shall remain in an incidental use to the host dwellinghouse at&nbsp;<a href="https://harrow-planning.idoxcloud.com/locations/index.html?fa=edit&amp;id=1950810" target="_blank" data-id="1950810" class="trigger_location_popup no-underline" style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(114, 175, 210); outline: none; outline-offset: -2px;"><span data-update-object-name="Location" data-update-object-id="1950810" data-update-field-name="dtf_location_id">101 Balmoral Road, South Harrow, Harrow, HA2 8TE</span></a>&nbsp; . Any other material change of use would require planning permission.</p><p><br></p>
